name: Last Prayers of the Doomed
source: Pathfinder #215: To Blot Out the Sun
description: Influenced by the last prayers of the dead, creatures experience extreme claustrophobia and batter at the walls and floor, desperate to escape, see the sun, and breathe fresh air—but their prayers go unanswered.
disable: DC 26 Religion check (expert) to disrupt the haunt through prayer, or DC 26 Deception check or DC 26 Diplomacy check DC 27 (expert) to convince the spirits you'll free them from this place

offensiveAbilities.name: Let Me Out!
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the altar, corpse, or statue

Effect The triggering creature batters their fists and body into the floor and walls, dealing 4d10+18 bludgeoning damage to themself (DC 25 basic Will save). All creatures who witness this become Frightened 2 unless they succeed at a DC 25 Will save.
